title: galium erythrorrhizon var. debeauxii
intro: Galium erythrorrhizon var. debeauxii, commonly known as the Red Galium or Beaux's Galium, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. It is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Galium erythrorrhizon var. debeauxii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
